listingTitle: Keep untrusted workflow data out of shell templates
title: Keep untrusted workflow data out of shell templates
why: GitHub expands expressions before invoking the shell, so attacker-controlled event or dispatch values can inject commands into a generated script.
suggestion: Assign the expression to an env value, validate it where appropriate, and reference the quoted shell variable from run.
limitations: Only direct run commands in checked-in .github/workflows YAML files are inspected.

String inputs, github.event fields, and github.head_ref are treated as untrusted contexts; typed boolean, choice, and number workflow inputs are excluded. The rule does not perform cross-step data-flow analysis.
